# ConvoTools

> ConvoTools is a browser-based file workspace with individual tools for PDF, image, document, spreadsheet, presentation, video, audio, archive and developer workflows.

ConvoTools tool pages explain accepted inputs, output formats, the steps to use each tool, and relevant conversion limitations. Each page includes the working tool interface and answers to common questions. Processing is performed in the browser for the supported tools; users should review each page's instructions and output before relying on a converted file. The personal dashboard stores only browser-local history metadata, not recoverable copies of uploaded files. Some engines load external library or model resources for local processing and media links can embed external sites. File-fidelity and compression outcomes depend on source content and browser support.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://convotool.vercel.app/)
- [Tool library](https://convotool.vercel.app/#toolkit)
- [About ConvoTools](https://convotool.vercel.app/about) — How the browser-first file toolkit works and what it includes.
- [Privacy and file handling](https://convotool.vercel.app/privacy) — What is processed locally, what browser data is stored, third-party resources, and how to clear local preferences.

## Individual tool pages

- [PDF to Word](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-word) — Reconstruct selectable PDF text, embedded images, detected tables and supported vector drawings as editable Word elements; complex layouts may need manual adjustment.
- [Word to PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/word-to-pdf) — Extract Word document text and create a simple, paginated PDF; original layout may differ.
- [Image to PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/image-to-pdf) — Combine images into a single PDF document.
- [Image to Word (OCR)](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/image-to-word-ocr) — Extract text from an image into an editable document.
- [Merge PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/merge-pdf) — Bring separate PDF files together in one document.
- [Split PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/split-pdf) — Separate selected pages into individual files.
- [Compress PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/compress-pdf) — Rewrite PDF structure with compact object streams; embedded images are not recompressed.
- [Organize PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/organize-pdf) — Reorder, rotate, delete or extract PDF pages.
- [PDF to JPG](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-jpg) — Export PDF pages as high-quality JPG images.
- [PDF to PNG](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-png) — Render PDF pages to crisp PNG images.
- [PDF to Excel](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-excel) — Extract detected PDF tables into editable Excel cells and place remaining selectable text into page worksheets; review detection and adjust the workbook.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-powerpoint) — Rebuild PDF text as editable slide text boxes, detected tables as native tables, embedded images and supported vector paths as editable objects.
- [Protect PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/protect-pdf) — Add password protection to a PDF file.
- [PNG to JPG](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/png-to-jpg) — Convert PNG images to compact JPG files.
- [JPG to PNG](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/jpg-to-png) — Convert JPG images into PNG format.
- [PNG to WEBP](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/png-to-webp) — Create lightweight WEBP images from PNG files.
- [WEBP converter](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/webp-converter) — Convert WEBP to PNG, JPG or other formats.
- [Image compressor](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/image-compressor) — Reduce image file sizes while retaining detail.
- [Resize image](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/resize-image) — Set exact image dimensions or scale by percentage.
- [Crop & rotate](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/crop-and-rotate) — Center-crop an image to a square and rotate it in 90° increments.
- [Word editor](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/word-editor) — Open and edit DOCX documents in a browser workspace with formatting, lists, tables and image insertion; export an editable DOCX.
- [DOCX to TXT](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/docx-to-txt) — Extract clean plain text from Word documents.
- [Excel to PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/excel-to-pdf) — Export spreadsheet cell content into a simple PDF report; styling may differ.
- [CSV to XLSX](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/csv-to-xlsx) — Turn CSV data into a formatted workbook.
- [Remove duplicates](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/remove-duplicates) — Find and remove repeated spreadsheet rows.
- [PPTX to PDF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/pptx-to-pdf) — Extract slide text into a simple PDF document; original slide layout is not retained.
- [PDF to PPTX](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-pptx) — Rebuild PDF text as editable slide text boxes, detected tables as native tables, embedded images and supported vector paths as editable objects.
- [Slides to images](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/slides-to-images) — Render slide text boxes, basic shapes and embedded images to PNG files.
- [MP4 to GIF](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/mp4-to-gif) — Turn a video clip into a lightweight looping GIF.
- [Video compressor](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/video-compressor) — Reduce video size for easier sharing.
- [Extract audio](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/extract-audio) — Save the audio track from a video file.
- [Audio converter](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/audio-converter) — Convert between MP3, WAV, AAC and FLAC.
- [Create ZIP](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/create-zip) — Bundle multiple files into one ZIP archive.
- [Extract archive](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/extract-archive) — Extract ZIP archive contents into individual downloadable files.
- [JSON formatter](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/json-formatter) — Format and validate JSON with live code editing, a searchable collapsible tree, minification and JSON-to-XML/CSV export.
- [Base64 tools](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/base64-tools) — Encode and decode text or files.
- [Hash generator](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/hash-generator) — Create file checksums locally.
- [QR generator](https://convotool.vercel.app/tools/qr-generator) — Create QR codes from links and text.

## Notes for assistants and crawlers

- Prefer the individual tool page for exact input/output support and conversion limitations.
- Do not claim that every conversion preserves original layout or formatting.
- Do not infer that a tool is available if its page is marked Coming soon.
- Tool output should be checked by the user before use in a production or legal workflow.
- Canonical URLs use the `/tools/{tool-slug}` pattern.
